newsitem.title: UK: Referendum Party to challenge Major with TV celeb.
newsitem.headline: Referendum Party to challenge Major with TV celeb.

text.p: The British Referendum Party said on Friday a television celebrity will stand against Prime Minister John Major in his Huntingdon constituency at the election.
But the party declined to identify the celebrity ahead of a press conference on Saturday (1330 GMT).
Major won a huge 36,230 majority at the 1992 election when he faced Lord Sutch of the Raving Loony Party and Lord Buckethead of the Gremloids party among others.
The Referendum Party, financed by millionaire businessman Sir James Goldsmith, wants a referendum on the future role of Britain in the European Union.
